RainSoundClosedMultiplierComment: Volume multiplier when closed (0.0=silent, 0.5=50%, 1.0=same as open)
WindSoundClosedMultiplierComment: Volume multiplier when closed (0.0=silent, 0.5=50%, 1.0=same as open)
PerishRateOpenComment: Food spoilage rate when open (1.2 = 20% faster)
PerishRateClosedComment: Food spoilage rate when closed (0.8 = 20% slower)
AnimationSpeedComment: Speed of opening/closing animation (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast)
